recommendation_scope: Proceed with the selected development P0 observation and role-handoff application under its declared advisory limits. This does not authorize a patch, publication or production effect.

risk.rationale: The reviewed phase only inspects the declared task-owned development workset and produces non-executable observations; target content classification and authority remain declared and unverified.

bounded_findings: The selected profile applies only to repository multi / agent-framework / development; the exact issue comes from the current task binding.
Checkpoint/track observe the declared owned workset through workspace.inspect; this does not authorize a patch or intercept all writes.

Publication observation is specified for an actual commit before an existing authorized push; it is separate from workspace assessment and preserves baseline, destination, ownership, non-force and host checks.
P0 outcomes are advisory and errors are explicit; continuing an independently authorized legacy action is not a new blocking gate.
Internal data classification, low risk and reversibility are profile declarations, not content scanning or authenticated facts.
Local actor/reviewer labels are unauthenticated; distinct labels do not establish trusted service identity or OS isolation.
An allow observation has executable=false and authority_verified=false and cannot serve as a grant, legal certification or P1/P2 enforcement evidence.
conditions: Assess only a fresh current record bound to the frozen candidate and exact policy digest.
Keep development-only selection, exact existing Git standing authorization and host restrictions unchanged.
Report observation failures, stale state, declared metadata and unauthenticated identity without overstating assurance.
Obtain independent evaluator assessment for the same exact observation and linked governance record.
unresolved_obligations: Candidate content sensitivity is not automatically verified by this P0 feature.
Protected identity, execution gating, credential isolation and organization-specific regulatory applicability are outside this application scope.
actual_commands: python runtime/repoctl.py startup --repo multi --project multi --service agent-framework --environment development --issue p0-workflow-application

cli_assessment.notes: The workflow accepted this exact snapshot/policy binding while fresh. Actual independent evaluation is still required; review_pending was not represented as completed. Two preliminary bounded record-display helpers used incorrect top-level key locations, were corrected to snapshot scope/policy keys, and made no record changes.

review_triggers: Changed workset, profile, target, policy, observer implementation or runtime identity
Observation expiry or a newer selected record
Any proposed P1 gate or P2 enforcement claim
next_action: Independent evaluator must review and assess the same fresh observation with the recorded governance digest. Publication observation is a separate actual-commit record and must not inherit this workspace recommendation as authority.
